name: contractcopilot-monorepo
description: AI-Powered Legal Document Risk Scanner - Monorepo

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run --with fastapi --with 'uvicorn[standard]' --with pydantic-settings uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run black . && uv run isort .
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules frontend/dist backend/.venv backend/__pycache__ backend/.pytest_cache
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.docker:build:prod: cd backend && docker build -f Dockerfile.prod -t contractcopilot-backend:prod .

author: ContractCopilot Team
